themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, explore data, and interact with systems or users.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that aid developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including their efficiency, security, and impact on the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing and research purposes, including their creation, detection, and comparison with human respondents.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as articles, meeting transcripts, or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights how AI tools and techniques are being integrated into product management workflows for strategy, analysis, and feature development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Covers the comparative analysis and testing of various AI tools, including benchmarks, performance reviews, and user experience assessments.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines research into the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and societal impact of AI chatbots, including user interactions and potential harms.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Details the application of AI in gathering and analyzing qualitative data, such as interview synthesis, thematic analysis, and understanding user perceptions.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates the effects of AI on job creation, displacement, skill requirements, and the overall transformation of the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
